outcome: A signed-in person sees the client register and each client's billing contact, projects and money, and can set the billing contact, on the contract mock
acceptance_criteria: **Desktop fidelity.** `SCR-35-desktop` and `SCR-35-desktop-detail` each pass at `--width 1440`: `report.json` has `pass: true`, `scores.coverageWithExceptions` = 100, `scores.visual` >= 90. — verify: the command per board, exit 0.

**Phone fidelity.** `SCR-35-mobile` and `SCR-35-mobile-detail` pass at `--width 390`. `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt` lists all 4 with coverage, visual and pass. — verify: same command shape; rows in `scores.txt`.

**Exceptions are limited and explained.** Each entry of `delivery/features/F-19/fidelity-exceptions.json` has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` (`"builder proposal, pending design engineer"` until the design engineer signs) and falls under a Conflicts item below. No entry covers a value the contract can supply. — verify: file content; build.md maps each entry to a Conflicts number.

**Titles and the phone bar.** Desktop: one `h1` (`.shell-title`, computed 40px at 1440, the frame's size, Conflicts 11). Phone: one `h1` (26px at 390), `usePhoneBack` link named "Projects" (list) or "Clients" (detail); `main` has no back link. The 403/404 page has one `h1`. — verify: e2e reading `getComputedStyle` and the bar link on the four boards' states.

**List from the data only.** On the default list the six names appear in the returned order; Lagoon Health and Ojo Foods show "Missing · invoices can't start", the others "Set"; Tamarind Loans shows `0` projects; each row links to `/clients/{id}`. Text from a board that a fixture does not carry (an email in the list, "active", "closed", "Prospect · RFP", "READY", "NEEDS DETAILS" as board words) is absent from the DOM. — verify: component test on `list.json`; `grep` for those strings in the rendered text.

**Owed and unknown.** A row with `owed.unknown: true` shows "Unknown"; a row with no `owed` shows "Not given"; a known amount shows through `formatAmount`; nowhere does the DOM show `0`, `0.00` or an empty cell for an unknown value. — verify: component tests on list and detail (CL-3501 owed, CL-3507, CL-3509); `grep -rn "0\.00" frontend/src/features/clients` shows no default.

**Count line and paging.** With `psl_mock_clients=many` and `limit` 10 the list shows 10 rows, "10 clients loaded as of …" and "Show more"; pressing it requests `cursor=<next_cursor>` once, appends rows (no repeat), and when `next_cursor` is absent the button is gone and the line reads "25 clients as of …". A failed second page keeps the loaded rows and shows "Try again". The "N missing billing contact" figure appears only when `next_cursor` is absent. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` and mock test for cursor paging.

**List states.** `psl_mock_clients=empty` shows "No clients to show yet."; 5xx (`X-Mock-Scenario: 500` or stub) shows `WorkErrorCard` with Try again that only reads; 401 shows the signed-out callout with `next=/clients`; persona `none` (403) shows `NoAccessState`. — verify: component tests with `answers` stubs as `tests/projects*.test.tsx` do.

**Detail from the data only.** On `CL-3501` the page shows name "Lagoon Health Ltd", the banner text from `blocked[]`, empty inputs, project "Patient app" linking to `/projects/{case_id}`, money with owed "Unknown". On `CL-3509` (only required fields) there is no banner, no money section, "No projects yet.", and no empty placeholders. On `CL-3503` (`can_change: false`) there is no form or button, the values read-only, and "You can't change this client's details.". No address, tax ID, legal-name, PM, milestone or Contacts text is present anywhere. — verify: component tests on the four fixtures; text absent from the DOM.

**Save: request.** On `CL-3501` the Save button is off until both inputs are non-blank. A press sends one `PUT /api/v1/clients/CL-3501/billing-contact` with the CSRF header and exactly `{expected_revision: 3, name, email}` (no `reason`, no other key). A double press makes one request. A 200 reloads the detail once, shows the stored values, the "Billing contact saved." status, and the banner is gone because the backend stopped returning it. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` (request count and body asserted); mock test.

**Save: errors.** A 409 (`CL-3508`) reloads once, keeps what the person typed, shows the newer saved values and the changed-while-editing notice, resends nothing, and the next press carries the new `expected_revision` (asserted). A 422 puts the `email` message beside the email input (`aria-invalid="true"`, linked by `aria-describedby`) and the `name` message beside the name input, entries kept, no reload loop. A 403 reloads once and the reloaded `can_change` decides. A 401 shows the signed-out callout. A network error or 502 shows "We couldn’t confirm the change was saved.", reloads once and sends no second PUT; if that reload fails the form is off and "Try again" only reads. — verify: component tests with `answers` stubs and a recording `fetch`; counts asserted.

**Tenant and permission.** `CL-3599` (GET and PUT 404) and persona `none` (403) show `NoAccessState` with no client id, name or title in the document, tab title or phone bar; persona `none` gets 403 on each of the three operations on the mock; a PUT without the CSRF header gets 403 and the page shows the server message. The page never reads `/me` roles to show or hide the form. — verify: component tests; `tests/clients-mock.test.ts` per operation; `grep -rn "roles\|useMe" frontend/src/features/clients` finds no permission decision.

**Nothing is derived or enforced.** No code path blocks, warns or enables anything about invoices or eligibility; the "invoices can't start" words appear only as returned `blocked[]` lines or the two static copy lines named in Contract. No invoice, receipt, allocation or payment call exists. — verify: `grep -rn "invoice" frontend/src/features/clients` shows only copy and the money labels; no `fetch` outside the three operations.

**The mock matches v7.** `tests/clients-mock.test.ts` checks, for the three operations: 200 replies validate against the v7 schema (no stripping); 401/403/404/409/422 shapes; the check order; cursor paging and `limit`; the 409-then-newer-revision flow; the stored contact after a 200; every new fixture validates against the generated schema; `CL-3509` has every optional field absent. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/clients-mock.test.ts tests/clients.test.tsx`.

**Accessibility at both widths.** `e2e/clients.spec.ts` shows no axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 390 and 1440 on the list, the empty list, the detail (CL-3501), the detail with a 422 shown, the read-only detail (CL-3503) and the not-open state; no sideways scroll; visible focus rings and logical Tab order (rows, then name, email, Save); 44px targets; the table has real `th` headers and the phone cards are links with a readable name; "Unknown" is text, not colour alone; the 422 summary is announced (`role="alert"`) and focus moves to the first invalid input; no animation under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`. — verify: `cd frontend && E2E_PORT=4631 MOCK_PORT=4632 npx playwright test e2e/clients.spec.ts` with `timezoneId: 'Africa/Lagos'`; output in build.md.

**Tokens only.** `grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsl\(" frontend/src/features/clients/clients.css` returns nothing; colours, spacing and type use `src/styles/tokens.css` variables. — verify: the command.

**Existing behaviour is not weakened.** `tests/mock-projects.test.ts`, the projects tests, `tests/work-item*.test.tsx`, `tests/response*.test.*`, `tests/api-schema-drift.test.ts`, `tests/mock-contract.test.ts` and the existing e2e specs pass unchanged. No removed `expect`, no loosened matcher. `git diff --stat` shows no edit to `frontend/src/shell/**`, `frontend/src/api/**`, `frontend/src/features/projects/**`, `architecture/**`, `package.json`, the lock file or the protected files, and `server.mjs` shows only the lines named in Lanes. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh` and the diff.
**No new dependency; no hard-coded data.** No new npm package. `grep -rn "Lagoon\|Harmattan\|Kora\|Ojo\|Sabi\|Tamarind" frontend/src` finds nothing outside tests. — verify: the two commands.

**build.md evidence.** build.md contains `scores.txt` for the 4 boards, `side-by-side.png` paths, the exception-to-Conflicts map, every contract question for the backend developer (fields the boards need that the schema lacks: see Conflicts) recorded as a contract proposal, and for each board under 90 the measured gap and cause. — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: Medium. It is a cross-layer contract the backend developer has not yet confirmed (D-CLIENTS-VIEW proposed, architecture/model.json:1607) and it includes one write (the billing contact, which gates later invoicing) plus a money display where unknown must never read as zero. It is not high because it is mock-only, the write is a single contained field with revision control, no invoice, payment or migration logic runs, and nothing is released. SURFACES: `ui`, `api` (new endpoints consumed) and `contract-change` (a still-proposed v7 contract). `payments` is not listed because only displayed money is in scope. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is not-required: it conforms to client-approved boards and adds no new business rule, with the board-versus-contract gaps handled as above.
